reviews.text:
The lady is fantastic, we loved being here!
She did a miracle with the cat!

I have a basis for comparison. Gabi really loves animals. I go to Gabi's with my 3-legged Havanese mix puppy. I'm always there, waiting for the puppy. She treats my puppy with love. She's also a good person, kind, she once took me home because she was very warm and looked after my puppy and didn't ask for money for it. She's a good person, she helps where she can.

The best beautician in the area.🥰
I can only recommend her.

I called for an S.O.S haircut, it was about a rescued Persian kitten that day who was a complete mess. To my great surprise, he was able to squeeze it in for the day, he did an amazing job, and last but not least, the owner had a fabulous personality:) My kitten and I are so grateful, I highly recommend him!!🫶🏻 …
I was very satisfied with everything. Thank you!

We have three Havanese puppies, all of them stayed calm from the first minute, Gabi is brilliant at understanding their language. The atmosphere is extremely peaceful, she always takes care of them according to what has been discussed, she does professional, aesthetic work. You can feel free to talk to her, she is very friendly, she also kindly shares and suggests care advice and training instructions. I CAN ONLY RECOMMEND HER!

She is an extremely knowledgeable, kind, and animal-loving beautician. We always discuss it with her and she gives advice on what she recommends for a given dog based on their coat type and build. The end result is always very beautiful! I recommend her wholeheartedly!
You did a very nice job. Lujza, Samu and Zozó felt good the first time. :) Thank you very much!

Gabi is very attentive, she treats both dogs and cats professionally, it's clear that she does it from the heart 😊 ❤️
Zorka will be beautiful every time! …

Mar-Blue dog and cat cosmetics are a real salvation for us! Thanks to Gabi's expertise and patient attitude, the shedding season is not a nightmare for us - and my mixed breed puppy turns from a Scottish Shepherd into a Mudie at this time. :) I have no idea what would happen to us without Gabi and the cosmetics. I can highly recommend it to everyone!
